free_tier.stated: A free plan whose crons run every 15 minutes at minimum and whose workers are killed after 10 seconds idle, with a hard 6-hour ceiling on any worker: quoted 'Worker idle timeout | 10 sec' and 'Worker runtime | 6 hrs Absolute ceiling on a single worker's lifetime, regardless of plan'.

retention.stated: The 10-second idle timeout ends any process that is not answering requests, so the host is a scheduler and not a machine: what survives is the cron every 15 minutes, not a daemon.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: A 15-minute cron with 100,000 runs a day for nothing is the cheapest scheduler in this class, and 'Email yourself' makes it a free alerting path for a box that is expected to die.

limits.value: worker idle timeout 10 sec; worker runtime at most 6 hrs on any plan; execution timeout 1 min per run on the Free plan

limits_note: Free plan: minimum cron interval 15 min, execution timeout 1 min per run, 1,000 authenticated API requests per minute and 0 private vals; a worker has 4 GiB of memory.
